==Walkthrough==
*Speak to [[Gantineux]] at (E-10).
*Head to [[The Eldieme Necropolis]] and look for a '''???''' that spawns in one of four locations.
**(I-7) on Map 2.
**(I-10) on Map 2.
**(M-6) on Map 2.
**(D-5) on Map 2.
*Click the '''???'''.
**The incense will always fail to light.
*Return to [[Gantineux]], then talk to [[Eperdur]] in [[Northern San d'Oria]] (M-7).

==Walkthrough==
*Speak to a Bastok [[Gate Guard]].
*Go to [[Cid]] at (G-8) in [[Metalworks]], talk to him, and receive the {{KI}} [[Blue acidity tester]].
*Enter [[Dangruf Wadi]] from [[South Gustaberg]] (D-9).
*Use the geyser at (I-8) until the tester becomes the {{KI}} [[Red acidity tester]].
*Return to [[Cid]].
